about.en: ARC is the utility token of ARC, a project building infrastructure for privacy-preserving, efficiency-oriented AI models through its Reactor and Matrix products. The token is an ERC-20 at 0x672fdBA7055bddFa8fD6bD45B1455cE5eB97f499 on Ethereum and is used for access, staking and governance in the ARC ecosystem. MEXC lists it under the exchange symbol ARCAI.
